_comment: MU Linux 0.97k Pterodactyl egg. Import in a PTDL_v2 Panel.
name: MU Linux 0.97k Server
author: support@mu-linux.com
description: MU Online 0.97k services. The installer downloads the selected release into the server volume; the runtime image contains only dependencies and the Pterodactyl entrypoint.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "${ARCH}" in
  x86_64) ASSET_ARCH=amd64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) ASSET_ARCH=arm64 ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported architecture: ${ARCH}" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
REPOSITORY=EmanuelCatania/Mu-Linux-0.97k
ASSET=mu-linux-97k-server-${ASSET_ARCH}.tar.gz
URL=https://github.com/${REPOSITORY}/releases/download/${MU_RELEASE_TAG}/${ASSET}
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Downloading ${ASSET} from ${MU_RELEASE_TAG}..."
curl --fail --location --retry 3 "${URL}" -o /tmp/mu-server.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/mu-server.tar.gz -C /mnt/server
rm /tmp/mu-server.tar.gz
chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh /mnt/server/ConnectServer/ConnectServer /mnt/server/JoinServer/JoinServer /mnt/server/DataServer/DataServer /mnt/server/GameServer/GameServer
echo "MU Linux 0.97k server installed."
